summary: Buyer/customer flow is implemented with Stripe billing and explicit pricing plans. The pricing page (frontend/app/pricing/page.tsx) offers data plans and provider plans. Stripe integration handles payments. The pricing tests (frontend/lib/pricing-provider-cta.test.ts, frontend/lib/pricing-plan-path.test.ts) verify pricing page integrity. The revenue path contracts test (frontend/lib/revenue-path-contracts.test.ts) validates commercial flows. The README mandates that checkout and billing capabilities are governance-controlled with explicit approval gates. Live site has /pricing route and Stripe Payment Link integration.
assertions: Pricing page with data plans and provider plans, tested via pricing-provider-cta.test.ts

Live site at /pricing shows plan tiers; Stripe connect-src in CSP header
